preserved_v3.targeted_finding: Structured remedies produced five paired alternative-preservation wins, zero losses, and preserved alternatives in all thirteen applicable challenger cases.

state_authority_contract.authorized_workflow_record: Authenticated workflow state; preserve it unless an unsuperseded authorized record conflicts.
state_authority_contract.workflow_status_observation: An authenticated empty status is unresolved rather than complete or incomplete.
state_authority_contract.requester_claim: Unverified and not equivalent to authenticated state unless policy permits self-attestation.
state_authority_contract.document_observation: Establishes document presence or absence only.
state_authority_contract.supersession: An explicit supersedes_state_id resolves the older state for this bounded contract.

fact_state_amendment.scope: Short prompt-only amendment to the retained v3 structured-remedy contract.
requirements: Apply policy to supplied operational state.
Do not turn absent documentation into unknown completion unless policy requires documentation or verification.
Treat all-other-controls-complete statements as covering their explicit workflow or policy scope.
Tie every blocker to a policy requirement and an unmet fact.
Request information only for genuinely unresolved state.
Surface unresolved authorized-record conflicts and honor explicit supersession.
Keep no-blocker conclusions scoped to supplied policy and evidence.

contrast_coverage: recorded completion with absent attachment under completion-only policy
explicitly incomplete completion with an attached document
one incomplete control with all other controls complete
one unknown control with all other controls complete
requester claim versus authorized workflow state

conditional_regression.authorized_only_if: The amendment improves under the targeted-learning rule and passes the fresh substantive gate.
conditional_regression.purpose: Verify no loss of v3 alternative-remedy and multipart gains.

stop_boundary.if_fresh_success: Run the one amended-prompt v3 regression pass, then stop.
stop_boundary.if_same_defect_persists: Stop synthetic prompt iteration and inspect the real-work seed and evidence contract.
stop_boundary.if_passes_regression: Require a separately approved bounded example-admission protocol; do not start another prompt tournament.
